e9464fd369a55632f7a6b5c98a2e31b4.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Regional-industry Factories Nearing Inauguration
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 5 (KCNA) -- This year has witnessed the proud and epochal achievements in the regional construction, which made another leap forward in ensuring modernity, economic profitability and prospect with a goal of reaching a level set higher than last year, according to the far-reaching regional development strategy of the great Workers' Party of Korea.

Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, inspected regional-industry factories in several counties nearing inauguration on December 3.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was accompanied by Jo Yong Won and Pak Jong Chon, secretaries of the WPK Central Committee.
First, he went round the regional-industry factories in Sinyang County, South Phyongan Province.

He was greeted on the spots by the commanding officers of the army units involved in the construction, officials of design institutes, senior officials of the Party and power organs in Sinyang County and officials of the regional-industry factories.

He went round the production, cultural and welfare facilities of the foodstuff factory, garment factory and daily necessities factory in the county one by one to learn in detail about their construction and preparations for operation.

Saying that he could see the level of construction and technical equipment of the construction units has remarkably improved as compared with last year, he expressed satisfaction over the fact that lopsidedness has been definitely decreased and the level of balance and specialization increased in the whole construction process.

Noting that the evaluation of the quality of construction depends on the final construction, he indicated the orientation and ways for the construction units at all levels to radically raise the level of specialization and delicacy in the final construction.

He said that there might be difficulties as healthcare facilities, leisure complexes and others are expected to be added to regional construction projects from the coming year but the People's Army has tremendous potentiality for creditably guaranteeing the implementation of the Party's policy on regional development and will powerfully lead the regional construction revolution to a steady victory with its rich experience and heated enthusiasm for struggle.

Saying that modern regional-industry factories have been built in 40 cities and counties in less than two years since the regional-industry revolution started, he noted this represents the eye-opening regional changes. The rural construction and regional-industry construction are a gigantic revolution intended to fundamentally improve the quality of the people's living and lay the material and technical foundations for the independent development of the cities and counties, he said, underlining that we are right now passing through the most responsible and important historic period of transition.

He pointed out some deviations revealed in the construction of regional-industry factories and set forth some important tasks for operating the factories, normalizing their production and accommodating the inhabitants.
He inspected regional-industry factories in Pukchang County, South Phyongan Province.

Referring to the inconsistency in architectural and process designs in the construction of a foodstuff factory, he said that the irrational changes were made in contrast to the original design leading to the re-construction, which was attributable to the lack of proper guidance system and functional system to rectify such deviations in time.

In order to ensure high quality in construction as required by the drive for modernization and standardization and perfectly build factories as entities immediately demonstrating our style of civilization and development, it is necessary to establish a more thorough system of tripartite consultation between design, construction and management units, put construction on a scientific and integrated basis and steadily increase the proportion of dry construction in the building of industrial facilities and encourage it, he said.

Noting that the regular production and supply of various consumer goods basic and essential for the people's livelihood is the most important task in carrying out the Party's policy on regional industry, he put particular emphasis on the need to increase the number of varieties of specialties preserving the characters of regional areas and improve the quality of daily necessities.

He said that it is important for the whole Party and the state to pay attention to the development of regional economy, organize regional products shows every year and conduct significant reviews and appraisals of them so that regional-industry factories develop through competition.

Saying that the People's Army was assigned the historic task of regional changes and this is an expression of the noblest trust of the Party, the revolution, the era and the people in it, he expressed expectation and belief that the officers and men of the construction units would continue to give full play to the fighting spirit and creative mettle peculiar to the revolutionary army in the vanguard of the cause of realizing the long-cherished desire of the WPK and the wishes of the regional people.
He visited the Unsan Paper Factory newly built in Unsan County, South Phyongan Province.
He was greeted by Ri Kyong Chol, chief secretary of the South Phyongan Provincial Committee of the WPK, and officials concerned and officials of the factory.

Saying that the paper factory has been built first in Unsan County of South Phyongan Province on a trial basis according to the Party's decision on setting up the modern paper factory in all provinces capable of satisfying their own demands, he stressed that the factory is of great significance in developing the Korean-style paper-making industry and satisfying the long-term nation-wide demands.

Looking at the multipurpose paper machine, the toilet-paper machine, the one for moulding paper into paper containers and others, all of which are associated with the pioneering spirit and creation enthusiasm of the scientists, technicians and workers, he said that it is really laudable that several enterprises of South Phyongan Province and the Paper Engineering Institute of the State Academy of Sciences are taking the lead in solving one of the problems which greatly concern the Party. He noted that he is pleased that the said institute has a clear prospective goal for developing our own paper-making method and technology. He extended praise and encouragement to the scientists and technicians at the institute.

In order to meet the demand for paper badly needed for all the fields, including science, technology, education and cultural life, it is necessary to steadily develop our own paper-making method and technology based on the raw materials in the country, he said, adding that all other provinces should more thoroughly discuss and decide on the issue of building modern paper factories within the period of next five-year plan on the basis of the experience gained by South Phyongan Province in building a model factory.

The inauguration season has come to review the results of the proud one-year creation and labour campaign which will be estimated by the people, he noted, stressing that all the new regional-industry factories should make perfect preparations for their operation before their inauguration ceremonies which are due to be held in December. And he gave some instructions to promote the regional development policy. -0-

4d449d61d9b40edc2fdc6911f5ec0589.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Condolences to Russian President and Sympathies to Russian Embassy
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 9 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, sent a message of condolence to Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, on December 8 as regards the demise of Aleksandr Ivanovich Matsegora, Russian extraordinary ambassador to the DPRK, on December 6, 2025.

In the message, the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed deep condolences to the Russian president, the leadership of the Russian Federation and the bereaved family on behalf of the DPRK government and on his own behalf over the sudden demise of Aleksandr Ivanovich Matsegora, Russian ambassador to the DPRK.

Comrade Matsegora was a close friend and comrade of the DPRK people who devoted his whole life to the development of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations for over 30 years, he said, adding that the course in which the DPRK-Russia relations have developed into the present firm alliance is clearly associated with the devoted efforts of Comrade A. I. Matsegora who devoted his tireless passion true to the intention and will of the leaderships of the two countries.

The sudden demise of the ambassador at the present time when the development of relations between the DPRK and Russia have entered a crucial historic phase is indeed a heartrending event and a great loss not only to the Russian government and people but also to him and the DPRK people, he said.

Although Comrade Matsegora left us regrettably, his noble life devoted to the militant friendship of the DPRK and Russian peoples and to the accomplishment of their common cause will shine forever and will be always remembered by the peoples of the two countries, Kim Jong Un said, sincerely hoping that the bereaved family's pain over the loss will be removed, and that peace will settle in their minds as soon as possible.
He expressed deep sympathy to the Russian embassy over the demise of Matsegora. -0-

a6e1b14ca0b36f948acb39bc598b5b2a.title: Enlarged Meeting of 13th Plenary Meeting of Eighth Central Committee of WPK Convened
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 10 (KCNA) -- The Enlarged Meeting of the 13th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) was convened on Dec. 9.

Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the C.C., the WPK, members and alternate members of the Political Bureau of the C.C., the WPK and members and alternate members of the C.C., the WPK.

Present there as observers were officials of departments of the C.C., the WPK, leading officials of ministries, national agencies and provincial-level guidance bodies, chief secretaries of the Party committees and chairpersons of the people's committees in cities and counties, leading Party and administrative officials of major industrial establishments and relevant commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
A presidium of the plenary meeting was elected.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un presided over the plenary meeting.

The plenary meeting approved the discussion on five agenda items including the review of the implementation of the Party and state policies and the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the Party in 2025 and the major issues related to the preparations for the Ninth Congress of the WPK and entered into the discussion on relevant agenda items. -0-

858acac071da489819643af07bbe4bd5.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Condolatory Visit to Russian Embassy
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 11 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, paid a condolatory visit to the Russian embassy here on December 10 as regards the demise of Aleksandr Ivanovich Matsegora, Russian extraordinary ambassador to the DPRK.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un laid a bunch of flowers and observed a moment's silence in memory of Aleksandr Ivanovich Matsegora, who devoted his noble life to boosting and developing the DPRK-Russia friendship.
He met with members of the bereaved families and leading members of the embassy and expressed deep condolences to them.

He said that Matsegora was an able diplomat who made a tangible contribution to the history of the DPRK-Russia friendly relations and a close friend and true comrade deeply kept in the hearts of the DPRK people as a human being.

Saying that it is, indeed, a deep sorrow and great loss to not only the Russian government and people but also the government and people of the DPRK to lose the ambassador at a time when an important historic phase has been opened in the development of the relations between the two countries, Kim Jong Un stressed that even though he passed away, our respect and memories of him would last forever and the DPRK-Russia relations continue to develop as he hoped. -0-

d4a07fb1674df4d7b650d8cdbc247817.title: Second-day Sitting of 13th Plenary Meeting of Eighth Central Committee of WPK Held
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 11 (KCNA) -- The second-day sitting of the 13th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held on December 10.

Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, made an important conclusion on the agenda items on the review of the implementation of the major Party and state policies and the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the Party in this year and the preparations for the Ninth Congress of the WPK that were discussed at the first-day sitting of the plenary meeting.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un gave an assessment by the Party Central Committee of the implementation of the policies of the Party and state in 2025 and made a review of the major successes achieved in this year.
The plenary meeting discussed a series of problems to be immediately solved till the Ninth Congress of the Party and assigned the important tasks related to the preparations for the Party's congress.
It discussed the organizational matter.
It organized a state budget deliberation team and entered into the examination and discussion on the implementation of the state budget for 2025 and the draft state budget for 2026. -0-

a0bb972b4a92190b703d31217f46d4d4.title: Press Release on Enlarged Meeting of 13th Plenary Meeting of Eighth Central Committee of WPK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 12 (KCNA) -- The Enlarged Meeting of the 13th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea was held from Dec. 9 to 11 to sum up the major Party and state affairs in 2025 and to decide on a series of important issues at present including the preparations for the Ninth Congress of the WPK.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea, attended the plenary meeting.

Present there were members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the WPK and, as observers, officials of the departments of the Party Central Committee, leading officials of ministries, national agencies and provincial-level guidance bodies, chief secretaries of the Party committees and chairpersons of the people's committees in cities and counties, leading officials of the Party and administrative bodies of major industrial establishments and the relevant commanding officers of the Korean People's Army.
A presidium of the plenary meeting was elected.
The Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee authorized the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to preside over the plenary meeting.
Kim Jong Un referred to the main features of this year's struggle in which more gigantic projects were launched and great changes were made compared with any other year.

Saying that the greater steps we take forward for the development of the state and the well-being of the people across the country, the more we should never be conceited ourselves over the initial achievements and only when we correctly find out the factors creating artificial difficulties in our way ahead, fiercely struggle against the negative phenomena and elements, regarding them as the main target, and draw lessons in time, can the Party lead the revolution and construction properly, he stressed the need for the members of the central leadership body of the Party to take an active part in the discussion of agenda items with a deep understanding of the purpose of convening the plenary meeting and the importance of the issues to be discussed.
The plenary meeting brought up the following agenda items:
1. On the review of the implementation of the policies of the Party and the state in 2025
2. On the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the Party in 2025
3. On the important issues related to the preparations for the Ninth Congress of the Party
4. On the implementation of the state budget for 2025 and the draft state budget for 2026
5. Organizational matter
The plenary meeting unanimously approved the proposed agenda items.
It discussed the first agenda item "On the review of the implementation of the policies of the Party and the state in 2025".
There was a report on the first agenda item.

The report introduced the remarkable successes made in this year's struggle in which significant changes were made in the overall work of the state under the correct leadership of the Party Central Committee and analyzed in detail a series of shortcomings revealed by some Party organizations, state economic organs and others in the course of implementing the policies of the Party and the state, their causes and the lessons drawn from them.
After the report, leading officials at all levels made speeches and presented written speeches.

The speakers made reports on the work of their sectors to implement the important tasks set forth at the eleventh and twelfth plenary meetings of the Eighth Party Central Committee and suggested the measures to the plenary meeting.
Kim Jong Un made relevant evaluation of the presented issues.
The plenary meeting discussed the second agenda item "On the work of the Central Inspection Commission of the Party in 2025".

The report on the item referred to the successes made in the struggle for implementing the line of building the Party discipline in the new era and cited, based on data, the deviations revealed by the Party inspection committees at all levels.
The plenary meeting discussed the third agenda item "On the important issues related to the preparations for the Ninth Congress of the Party".

Presented to the plenary meeting were a series of issues related to the preparations for successfully holding the Ninth Congress of the Party which will serve as a signal turning point in dynamically promoting the development of our Party and further amplifying the motive force for the comprehensive development of the socialist construction.

The report referred to the issues including those of forming the preparatory committee for the Party Congress, organizing groups according to panels and sectors, drafting the amendments to the rules of the Party to be proposed for the approval of the Party Congress and reviewing the work of the leadership bodies of the Party committees at all levels, and to the method of electing the delegates to be sent to higher Party conferences and the Party Congress.
Kim Jong Un made an important conclusion related to the discussion of the first, second and third agenda items.
He gave the Party Central Committee's appraisal of the execution of the Party and state policies in 2025 and summarized major successes.
The general appraisal of this year's work is the accelerated speed of advance and redoubled self-sustenance.

In despite of various challenges and difficulties, the major industrial sectors of the national economy carried out their highly-set production plans in a responsible manner through the vigorous campaign for increased production and economization, the agricultural sector recorded higher grain yields over last year and a lot of major construction projects were successfully completed, and thus the five-year plan was carried out along with the achievement of the objectives of this year's economic development.

The modernization of major sectors of the national economy and the reinforcement of technical infrastructure have reached the final stage and it provided possibility and guarantee for more confidently entering into the fulfillment of the long-term goals for the next stage.

In particular, the important success is that we achieved proud results in realizing the ideal and well-being of the people and demonstrated to the full the simultaneous development of our state by launching and completing the projects stipulated in more expanded and advanced regional development policy within this year.

The significant achievements gained in accordance with the Party's policy on modernizing overall components of the national defence capabilities made it possible to solve many issues effectively and correctly and advance along the exact direction to ensure the security and defence of the country and protect its interests despite the global geopolitical and technological changes.

The signal military gains made by units of different arms of the Korean People's Army in the overseas military operations over the past nearly one year demonstrated to the world the prestige of our army and state as the ever-victorious army and genuine protector of the international justice.

The celebrations of the 80th founding anniversary of the WPK held this year showed to the world the absolute dignity and irresistible might of our Party, state and people and redoubled the strong will of all the people to build a socialist society with their wisdom and efforts and in their own way.
The field of sports, too, contributed good results to highly enhancing the prestige of the country.

Kim Jong Un said that 2025 is, indeed, a historic year of great change that broke through the last line of carrying out the five-year plan with confidence in the dynamic spirit of advance for the comprehensive development and charged the motive power for vigorously going over to a new stage.

The plenary meeting unanimously recognized that the key to adorning the year with gigantic successes while advancing along the course of development set by itself, remaining unfazed by worldwide confusion and change and any challenge and obstacle, lies in holding aloft the banner of ideology. It also recognized that it is important to consistently maintain and further develop the unique mode of struggle and revolution of working miracles by dint of ideology in the future advance.
Kim Jong Un pointed out the shortcomings and evil practices that must be corrected for the higher qualitative development of the socialist construction.

The conclusion assessed in detail the work of the Secretariat of the Party Central Committee and the state leadership organs this year, analyzed the factors creating artificial obstacles to the development of the revolution, and strictly criticized the wrong ideological viewpoint and inactive and irresponsible work attitude of some leading cadres and senior officials.

Kim Jong Un stressed the need to have greater confidence in and courage for the future of our cause and struggle, boldly rectify the shortcomings and deviations and continue to advance to carve out the future by dint of the unique mode of struggle and the might of self-sustenance.
He referred to some major tasks facing the Party, government and state organs at present.

Noting that provinces, cities, counties and the agricultural sector should draw up correct plans for farming well next year on the basis of this year's farming experience and push ahead with the preparations for farming, the conclusion set forth the tasks for boosting agricultural production and accelerating rural development including the issue of increasing the area under wheat cultivation until the people's dietary structure is changed, the issue of enhancing the wheat-processing capacity and the issue of reforming the distribution system to strictly observe the socialist principle of distribution.

Kim Jong Un analyzed in detail the present situation of the tideland farms and clarified the intention of the Party Central Committee to take a revolutionary step to transform the newly organized or the most backward farms among the tideland farms on the west coast into modern and civilized ones symbolizing the new transformation of rural development.

The conclusion called on provinces, cities and counties to take part in the work to strengthen the material foundation of the education sector and develop regional areas with the attitude befitting masters.

It called upon other provinces to make many changes suited to their regional characteristics simultaneously by learning from the experience of Kangwon Province which wonderfully built six power stations by its own efforts to provide a great asset for the development of the economy and the improvement of the people's living standard in the province and of South Phyongan Province which constructed the Unsan Paper Mill as a model of the country.
It referred to the principled issues and tasks arising in strengthening the country's financial and foreign trade disciplines.
Kim Jong Un put special emphasis on directing nationwide efforts to the transformation of coal-mine villages.

He said that the industrial development and independent economic development of the country are unthinkable without the improvement of the living environment and culture of the coal-mine villages and the change of the people's understanding of the coal front. He noted that various undertakings have been carried on in several aspects at an accelerating pace to eliminate the gap between towns and villages in recent years, adding that the additional forming of another new front for the improvement of the coal-mine areas is an important task facing us at present for the long-term development of the country.

The conclusion referred to the tasks for protecting the ecological environment and the measures for preserving the true nature of the socialist society with absolute service to the popular masses as its physiology by ensuring that the Party organizations at all levels thoroughly observe the policy requirement of giving priority to the popular things for the people.
Kim Jong Un stressed the need to make good preparations for the Party Congress and clarified the measures for organizational and political work to be taken throughout the Party.

He clarified the tasks for ensuring the successful holding of the Party Congress including the issue of completing pending major projects until the Ninth Congress of the Party, the issue for all sectors of properly setting the next five-year plans for qualitative development and proposing scientific and realistic ways for their implementation, the issue of heightening revolutionary vigilance and intensiveness and thoroughly establishing discipline and order in all fields, the issue for the Party organizations and working people's organizations at all levels of conducting the propaganda offensive for enhancing the political enthusiasm and spirit of advance peculiar to our people in various forms and methods and the issue of making full preparations for various political and cultural events.

Noting that the period until the Party Congress is a very important and responsible time for successfully concluding the work of the Eighth Central Committee of the Party and for the transition to a new phase of change thereafter, he stressed the important role of the leading cadres and senior officials at all levels including the members of the central leadership body of the Party.

He ardently called for putting more spurs to the daring and offensive fighting spirit and dynamically advancing to a new phase of change with the great pride and honour of turning the past five years into the great pioneering days of comprehensive rejuvenation.
All the participants fully supported the conclusion of Kim Jong Un.
The plenary meeting discussed the fourth agenda item "On the implementation of the state budget for 2025 and the draft state budget for 2026".
It decided to organize a state budget deliberation team for examining and discussing the implementation of the state budget for 2025 and the draft state budget for 2026.
It discussed the organizational matter as the fifth agenda item.
It decided to recall one member of the Party Central Committee and five alternate members of the Party Central Committee.
Pak Thae Song, premier of the Cabinet of the DPRK, informed the plenary meeting of the work of the state budget deliberation team.

The plenary meeting made a final discussion of the implementation of the state budget for 2025 and the draft state budget for 2026 and approved the submission of the documents on them to the Supreme People’s Assembly.
During the plenary meeting, a consultative meeting was held to select cities and counties where structures under the regional development policy are to be built in 2026.
Jo Yong Won reported the results of the above-said consultative meeting to the plenary meeting.
The plenary meeting confirmed the 20 cities and counties where the structures under the regional development policy are to be built in 2026 and approved them with unanimous approval.
Kim Jong Un concluded the plenary meeting.
The Eighth Central Committee of the WPK successfully went through the preparatory processes necessary to substantially complete the work of its term and enter the next stage of development.

The Enlarged Meeting of the 13th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK marked an important political occasion in clearly defining the road for new progress in socialist construction and vigorously promoting the all-people advance. -0-

27482c9fac14eda398dce36c3bd6105e.title: Ceremony of Welcoming Return of KPA Unit of Engineers Held with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 13 (KCNA) -- The Korean People's Army regards the absolute loyalty to the Workers' Party of Korea and the revolution as its sacred mission and duty and keeps performing brilliant military exploits with its unparalleled fighting spirit and through mass heroism, adding luster to the prestige and honor of our state.

The officers and combatants of the KPA unit of engineers who had been dispatched to an overseas operational area by the order of the Central Military Commission of the WPK returned home in triumph after fulfilling the assigned military task.

A ceremony took place with splendor at the plaza of the April 25 House of Culture in the capital city of Pyongyang on Dec. 12 to welcome the 528th Regiment of Engineers which returned home after carrying out the combat order of the Party in the overseas operational area.

The plaza was overflowing with great enthusiasm for welcoming the officers and combatants of the unit of engineers who demonstrated the irresistible might of our army again after the officers and men of the KPA special operations force performed legendary combat feats in an alien land to shine long in the history of building the Juche-oriented army.

The proud sons of the people who entered the plaza with the great pride of defending the absolute prestige of our state were warmly welcomed by officers and men of the KPA and citizens of the capital city.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the welcoming ceremony.

Present there were participants in the 13th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK and the large combined units of the KPA, families of the combatants of the regiment of engineers, service personnel, citizens and youth and students in Pyongyang.

When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived, service personnel and people raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" to reverberate throughout the sky of December, looking up to the ever-victorious iron-willed brilliant commander who has trained our armed forces into an invincible strong army, which is winning only victories by means of definite superiority in ideology, spirit and strategy and tactics, with his outstanding military strategic idea, rare commanding art and great trust and love.
Kim Jong Un sent a militant salute to the officers and men of the unit of engineers who defended the immortal reputation and prestige of the KPA and returned home with honor.
A commanding officer of the overseas engineers combat unit courteously reported to the Supreme Commander of the armed forces of the DPRK that the unit carried out the Party's combat order.
Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated the regiment on its proud combat achievements.
He made a speech in congratulation of the homecoming of the unit of engineers.

He warmly encouraged the officers and soldiers of the regiment of engineers who came back to the motherland after fully discharging their combat orders from the Party by displaying matchless bravery and specialized features and referred to pain of waiting for one hundred and twenty days in which he had never forgotten the beloved sons even for a moment and to the combat feats the regiment performed to shine forever in the history of the overseas military operations.

He said that the blood and sweat the soldiers of our armed forces shed and the sacrifice they made in the overseas operational area will never remain in vain and the feats the officers and soldiers of the 528th Regiment of Engineers performed will shine forever along with the fame of our powerful army.
Expressing gratitude and paying ennobling respect to the devoted service of the officers and soldiers who are always faithful to the country, he ended his speech.

When he finished his speech, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" once again, looking up to him with the boundless excitement and happiness of returning to the embrace of the father whom they yearned for and the greatest honor and pleasure of being blessed by the great brilliant commander.

Kim Jong Un proclaimed that the motherland decided to award the regiment the Order of Freedom and Independence 1st Class and nine combatants fallen in the course of completing their military missions the title of the DPRK Hero, the Order of National Flag 1st Class and the Order of Soldier's Honor 1st Class in order to highly appreciate and add eternal luster to the bravery displayed by the unit and its brilliant combat feats.
Upon the authorization of the Party and the government of the Republic, he fixed the order awarded by the motherland to the colours of the unit shining with the immortal feats.
The venue of ceremony was full of great emotion and joy of all the officers and men of the regiment of engineers.
Kim Jong Un warmly congratulated the soldiers of the regiment upon receiving the thanks and worthy honor offered by the Party, motherland and people.
There took place a march-past of the columns of the overseas engineers unit of the KPA with their glorious colours.
The participants enthusiastically applauded the soldiers of the unit of engineers who were granted a special favor of being reviewed by their supreme commander after making a report on victory.

Kim Jong Un met with the exemplary officers and combatants of the regiment of engineers and warmly encouraged them, highly appreciating the moral world and military feats of them who absolutely remain faithful to the order of the Party and the motherland.

The emotional scene of the venue of the ceremony in which the leader shared noble fraternal feelings with his soldiers was an impressive picture eloquently showing what made our motherland great and what made our army strong.

Kim Jong Un said that the motherland and people would always remember the military feats of the combatants of the unit of engineers who showed the feature of the true soldier, officer and human being who remain faithful to the motherland and people and are proud before them with their transparent faith and will and self-sacrificing efforts in battlefields, not with words and the bravery and heroism displayed by our soldiers in the sacred war for defending justice and dignity would be kept as the greatest pride of our state.

Expressing the belief and conviction that the brave combatants, who fully proved the law of the victory and development of the revolutionary army invincible with ideology and getting stronger by dint of it in overseas battlefield, would vigorously glorify the dignity and honor of the KPA with the worthwhile military feats of our generation, he had significant pictures taken with them, which will be eternally recorded in the history of army building.

At the end of the photo session, the venue of the ceremony resounded with the enthusiastic cheers reflecting the transparent faith and will of the combatants to more bravely struggle for the great Comrade Kim Jong Un and our great state and people.
Kim Jong Un visited the memorial wall erected at the central hall of the April 25 House of Culture.

Reverently recollecting the noble life of the martyrs who dedicated their lives to the sacred war for defending the honor and dignity of the country, he fixed the medal of the DPRK Hero, order of national flag and the order of soldier's honor beside their portraits.
He laid a white flower before the memorial wall and observed a moment's silence, hoping that the noble soul and spirit of the martyrs will be immortal along with their honor.

And flowers were placed before the memorial wall by commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK and the large combined units of the KPA, commanding officers of the regiment of engineers and the bereaved families of the martyrs.
Kim Jong Un met the bereaved families of the martyrs and warmly consoled them, sharing with them the pain of loss.
A performance was given to congratulate the return of the combatants who devotedly carried out the Party's combat order in the overseas operational area.

When Kim Jong Un appeared in the auditorium together with the commanding officers of the unit of engineers, the combatants broke into cheers, overcome by deep emotion of being honored with the highest glory and happiness in their lives under the care of the country and the great father whom they longed for even in their dreams.

The performers put on the stage songs of best wishes for the well-being of the motherland sung by the brave soldiers in battlefields of the alien land and the songs of the revolutionary army which always inspired them with unyielding courage and encouraged them to win victory.

The audience was filled with deep emotion by the images showing the self-sacrificing combat spirit, the loyalty and patriotism of the combatants of the unit of engineers, who dash into a mine field or a hail of bullets without hesitation and open the road of advance for victory to carry out the order of the leader and the Party.

Deeply moved by the traces our soldiers left in every bloody battlefield and their warm feelings, the audience was more firmly convinced that the motherland will be always strong as it has the reliable lifeguards who are possessed of the pure mind of remaining absolutely loyal to the Party, matchless heroism, ardent patriotism and comradeship as their mental qualities.

The performance was acclaimed by the audience as it reflected the firm will of the service personnel of the People' Army to reliably defend the security of the country and the people, holding the arms of the revolution more firmly while highly displaying the ideological and mental superiority peculiar to our army, through fine ideological and artistic depictions.
When the performance was over, the audience broke into stormy cheers again, looking up to Kim Jong Un.
Kim Jong Un warmly waved back to the officers and combatants of the unit of engineers as an expression of encouragement.

All the officers and men of the unit of engineers firmly pledged to cherish the heavenly love and trust of the great Party Central Committee as a vein of their destiny and nutrition fostering heroism and record only victories on the glorious colours shining with proud military feats of defending the motherland and revolution.
A reception was given in the evening to welcome the soldiers' homecoming.
Present on invitation were the officers and combatants of the 528th Regiment of Engineers, their families and officials concerned.
Also present there were leading officials of the Party and the government.

The spirit of carrying out the order of the Party unto death, mass heroism and unparalleled self-sacrificing spirit displayed by the officers and combatants of the 528th Regiment of Engineers of the KPA will be handed down forever along with the history of eternal victory of the powerful revolutionary army of the great Comrade Kim Jong Un. -0-

f7d52d004599994b128db02db06a9893.title: Speech of Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un at Ceremony of Welcoming Return of KPA Overseas Engineers Unit
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 13 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech at the ceremony of welcoming the return of the overseas engineers unit of the Korean People's Army.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Dear officers and soldiers of the 528th Regiment of Engineers of the Korean People’s Army,

I warmly welcome all of you, officers and soldiers of the regiment, back to your country. In performing your overseas mission you demonstrated the heroic spirit of our army and its specialized features with credit, and carried out your combat tasks in a responsible manner.
I really appreciate you all for coming back in good health.

Just as you yearned, every moment of the day on the foreign battleground, for all the precious things in your country, everyone in your country have never forgotten their beloved sons even for a moment.

Upon receiving the daily reports about your combats, I was deeply moved by the unyielding mettle you displayed in executing the orders from your Party and country death-defyingly. And each time, my wish grew stronger for every one of you to return safely and gladly.
In retrospect, for me, this can be said to be a year of longing; to the marrow of my bone, I have felt the pain of waiting that I have never experienced before.

One hundred and twenty days have passed since the moment when I had to dispatch you, combatants of this regiment, to the dangerous battleground; every day of this period seemed like a decade, just as when I had been waiting for the combatants of the special operations units, who had been involved in the liberation battles.
As the days went by, I found myself unable to accustom myself to, or get used to, worrying about the safety of the precious sons of this country who were fighting on the foreign battleground.
Now I feel at ease.
I am fairly relieved to see all of you come back like this.
You have fought very bravely.

True to the expectations of the Party, the country and all who are dear to your hearts, you displayed your mettle befitting true combatants, to the admiration of the world. Now you look more robust and dignified, and once again I warmly congratulate you, all the combatants of the regiment of engineers, for returning home with pride.
Comrades,
The 528th Regiment of Engineers is another proud combat unit that justly represents the matchless bravery and powerfulness of our army and its specialized features.

This regiment was formed on May 28 according to the decisions and orders of our Party Central Military Commission to build on the valuable victory in the overseas military operations. Early in August you, engineers of the regiment, left for the Kursk region of the Russian Federation, which your comrades-in-arms had retaken at the cost of their lives, and you achieved brilliant results in the course of performing your combat tasks there.

You fought in a life-and-death situation, braving the grave invisible dangers here and there, and your faith and willpower were tested every step of your way. Despite the harshness of the circumstances on the battleground, our engineers of the regiment never vacillated or hesitated, but all of you were courageous and responsible all the time.

As all of you, both officers and soldiers, displayed mass heroism overcoming unimaginable mental and physical burdens almost every day, you could work a miracle of turning a vast area of danger zone into a safe and secure one in a matter of less than three months, the task which was believed to be impossible to be carried out even in several years.

The cardinal importance of the battle results the regiment achieved this time lies evidently in that they were not feats performed by a few well-trained fighters but the fruition of mass heroism displayed by all the officers and soldiers.

In the rigorous battleground, where even a trifle slip or carelessness was not allowed and where even going to and from the battleground was accompanied by combats, you, caring for your comrades-in-arms first, shielded one another from the bursting shrapnel, and fulfilled your missions unto death even when you were critically wounded. Your ennobling comradeship, matchless self-sacrificing spirit and indomitability deserve everybody’s admiration, I believe.
I was convinced that our regiment of engineers would fight like that as they were ordered by the Party Central Committee.
Your brilliant battle results were also associated with the devoted efforts of the signalmen and medics who accomplished their tasks faithfully risking their lives almost every day.
All the officers and soldiers were equally brave, competent, devoted and heroic, indeed.
The fundamental key to the invincible fighting strength our regiment of engineers demonstrated in the alien battleground lies in the revolutionary fighting spirit that prevailed in the entire unit.

As definite precedence was given to political work, which was conducted in an ingenious, fresh and prompt way to suit the frontline situation, the spiritual and moral merits of our army were fully displayed typically to demonstrate the unconditional implementation of orders, loyalty, patriotism, unity between officers and soldiers, and comradeship.

What impressed me particularly were the performances given by company art groups in humble barracks on the holidays of September 9 and October 10, and the soldiers singing revolutionary songs on their way to the battleground and reciting the poems of their creation and writing letters to their home towns and villages at breaks of the mine-clearing hours.

Such a way of life could hardly be seen in such deadly circumstances unless they are men of optimism who are strong in faith and will as they are entirely filled with affection and respect for their Party, their country, their home towns and their parents and siblings and are firmly convinced of their victorious cause.

No other armies could imitate our service personnel’s ennobling ideological mentality of considering it a source of their honour instead of death to sacrifice themselves for their country, nor could they produce at any exorbitant cost mass heroism, a powerful weapon unique to our army.
The armed villains of the West, armed with whatever latest military hardware they are, cannot match this revolutionary army with an unfathomable spiritual depth.
It is regrettable that I cannot enumerate now all the combat feats performed by the hundreds of officers and soldiers of the regiment of engineers.
However, these feats will shine forever in the history of our army’s overseas military operations as well as in the history of the unit of engineers.
Comrades,
You left your homeland without much fanfare on receiving the order of the Party, but you have returned with something really great that adds to the glory of your country, your fellow people and army.
Your regiment accomplished the order unto death, but there was no reward or remuneration for it. Yet, it has earned the most valuable thing in the world that cannot be bartered for anything else.
That is the trust and confidence of the Party, the country and the people in our army.
Our army should expect nothing other than the trust of the Party, the country and the people.

By displaying an unrivalled fighting spirit and writing legendary tales in your combat records, you have faithfully and wonderfully lived up to the trust and confidence of your Party, your state and your fellow people in you.

The regiment of engineers has once again etched in history and highlighted in front of the world the unique mightiness of our army that has held ideological and spiritual perfectness, the core of which is the absolute loyalty to the Workers’ Party of Korea, as a banner of making itself a strong army. Herein lies the special significance of the feats performed by the regiment.

I, in the name of the Party and the country, extend thanks to all the officers and soldiers of the 528th Regiment of Engineers, who, by displaying matchless mass heroism and indomitable fighting mettle, carried out to the death the combat order issued by the Party and fully demonstrated once again the prestige of our state and the fame of the Korean People’s Army.
Comrades,
The priceless blood and sweat the regiment shed and the invaluable sacrifice it made in the course of perfectly carrying out the combat order of the Party will never remain in vain.
The immortal feats and exploits you performed will shine forever along with the fame of our powerful state and army and with our socialist country that will prosper infinitely.
Except the heartrending loss of nine lives, all the officers and soldiers of the regiment have returned to the motherland, and I express my thanks to you for this.

All the officers and soldiers of the armed forces of our Republic will regard the fighting spirit and exploits of the 528th Regiment of Engineers as another model. And your parents, siblings, wives and children, and the teachers of your alma maters will feel greatly proud of you.
I really feel proud of you, ranks of stalwart soldiers, and your powerful combat unit.
I hope that in the future, too, you will continue to perform brilliant exploits on the sacred road of safeguarding our great state and people.
The motherland decided to confer the Order of Freedom and Independence on your regiment in order to highly appreciate and add eternal glory to its bravery and brilliant combat feats.

In addition, it decided to award the title of Hero of the DPRK, Order of the National Flag 1st Class and Order of Soldier’s Honour 1st Class to the nine engineers who, to our regret, fell in the course of carrying out their combat orders.

Today I, upon authorization of the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party of Korea and the government of the Republic, will confer the Order of Freedom and Independence 1st Class on the colours of your regiment, its banner of victory and glory, and fix the orders on the portraits of our fallen comrades-in-arms.
I express my gratitude and pay ennobling respect to you, who are always faithful to your country, for your devoted service.
Long live the heroic Korean People’s Army! -0-

4342d5e00d0d4045102af6192b7ae6e8.title: Inaugural Ceremony of Kusong City Hospital Held with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 14 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea is powerfully carrying on the regional-industry revolution and the public health revolution, regarding the people's security and the promotion of their wellbeing as the foremost state affair, and the entities for prosperity are being erected one after another on this land thanks to its transparent outlook on people and its spirit of unconditionally serving them.

When the whole country has experienced the stirring changes and rejoiced at the news of the brilliant completion of the second year's task for implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy aimed to bring earlier the wonderful future of the construction of the ideal socialist society, Kusong City of North Phyongan Province greeted the day of inaugurating a base for advanced medical service conducive to the promotion of the health of its local people.

The Kusong City Hospital, which has been built thanks to the firm will of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un to make substantial changes in local areas in order to provide the people across the country with more civilized and happy living conditions and enable them to enjoy the benefits of modern healthcare and under his direct guidance, is a proud result brought about by the new era of the regional development.
The inaugural ceremony of the Kusong City Hospital for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy took place with splendor on December 13.

The venue of the ceremony was overflowing with the boundless pride and self-confidence of the builders, who are making their devotion to labor to realize the long-cherished desire of the Party Central Committee, and the great excitement and delight of the people in the city, who would enjoy the benefits of advanced medical service earlier than others under the solicitous care of the Party.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", shaking the sky and the earth.

They extended their warmest gratitude to Kim Jong Un, looking up to him who is making the great and devoted efforts full of the round-the-clock thoughts and troubles to open up an era of prosperity, in which all the people across the country lead an affluent and civilized life as soon as possible, subordinating all the state affairs to the people's wellbeing.

Present at the ceremony were the participants in the 13th Plenary Meeting of the Eighth Central Committee of the WPK, builders and officials of the Party and power organs and public health institutions and working people in North Phyongan Province and Kusong City.
Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee, made an inaugural address.

Upon authorization of the Party Central Committee, he extended warm thanks to the designers, builders, officials of the relevant fields and working people who have realized with perfect creative practice the Party's long-cherished desire to provide all the people in Kusong City with a wonderful hospital in which the popular character of socialist public health is really embodied.

He also warmly congratulated the citizens of Kusong City who would lead a more civilized life with the completion of the modern hospital and medical workers and employees of the hospital who became the masters of the new workplace.

He referred to the fact that in the wake of the completion of the Kangdong County Hospital which showed the perfect and new appearance of a regional hospital for the first time, the Kusong City Hospital has been successfully built based on the plan and principles of the WPK on the construction of hospital in the new era.

He stressed that the wise leadership of the WPK to lay new foundations for public health in the regions has already brought about world-level changes in different parts of the country in the first year and, in this course, the principle and methodology of the construction of hospitals to be built in all cities and counties have been confirmed and the foundations for vigorously pushing ahead with the modernization of public health with full capability and confidence in it have been laid.

Saying that the days when the good fruition cheered by the people in line with the demand of the times has been made are associated with the great dedication of the great father, he referred with emotion to the devoted efforts made by Kim Jong Un who has laid foundations for building up the public health capabilities one by one, prioritizing it as the sacred cause for the lives and health of the people.

He stressed that the modern hospitals built in different parts of the country are a valuable result of the people-first politics that can be achieved only by our Party and state which have subordinated everything in the state and social life to the promotion of the people's health and wellbeing.

Noting that when the tasks of the public health revolution are boldly and doggedly carried out by taking more steps forward after the present dynamic first step, our public health would clearly represent the genuine image of socialist Korea, he ardently called for devoting the patriotic wisdom and passion with the firm faith in the validity and vitality of the WPK's policies and thus bring earlier the future of a prosperous and powerful country full of laughter and happiness of the people.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape of the Kusong City Hospital.

Fireworks were displayed and a large number of balloons rose up over the venue of the ceremony to be specially recorded in the dynamic course of making the public health revolution in the new era, beautifully decorating the sky in meaningful December.

All the participants raised enthusiastic cheers with the unbounded pride of holding in high esteem the great leader, who is taking care of all the people across the country with great enthusiasm and affection, taking them to his arms and bestowing more loving care upon them, as the father of the large socialist family and the boundless reverence for him.
Kim Jong Un warmly waved to the participants in the ceremony, wishing the regional people happiness and their families good health.
He went round various places of the hospital.

He said that the Kusong City Hospital is another precious creation which shows the will of the Party to change and strengthen the regions and the steady development to be achieved by the overall public health of the DPRK and, at the same time, makes the meaning of 2025, the first year of the public health revolution, clearer.

Recalling that the December Plenary Meeting of the WPK decided to build modern hospitals in 20 cities and counties simultaneously from next year on the basis of the experience gained in building regional hospitals into model ones this year, he said that it stands out as a pressing issue to put the ranks of medical workers on an advanced level as early as possible and that the talent issue is fundamental to the public health revolution. He added that, to this end, it is important to radically reform the state medical education system to suit the reality of the country and take a revolutionary measure for training specialists in the public health sector.

He stressed the need to push ahead with the work for improving the clinical and technical level and academic qualifications of medical workers in a tactical and offensive manner, indicating the important tasks to be taken by the state.
He also underlined the need to make normative guides and provide a scientific and technological guarantee so that modern medical facilities and equipment can be managed and operated properly.

Saying that the issue related to the operation of hospital is also an important political one for defending the Party's policies and the people's trust in the Party, he stressed that the Kusong City Hospital, one of the model units for modernizing public health, should create a good exemplary experience for the development of regional public health in the course of its operation, too.

Saying that another perfect hospital has been built and its construction is perfectly successful, he highly appreciated the efforts of the builders who proved the vitality of the Party's policy on the development of public health with devoted labor struggle.

Regarding the construction of the city and county hospitals as an essential and the most important task for implementing the regional development policy and powerfully pushing ahead with it are the most right option of our Party and state fully responsible for the lives and health of the people and the way they should surely take without any moment's delay as they have no right to put off, he said, expressing his firm determination and will to build modern hospitals in 20 cities and counties every year and thus build solid foundations for the country's pubic health in the near future.

He stressed that leading cadres and senior officials at all levels including members of the central leadership body of the Party should buckle down to implementing the regional development policy with the viewpoint that everything starts from now and develop all cities and counties across the country in a balanced, accelerated and qualitative way so that every step of the present day would lead to a substantial and comprehensive change in the regional areas and to the realization of the far-reaching ideal of national rejuvenation.

Going round the hospital equipped with modern medical facilities and excellent conditions for medical service, the participants in the ceremony keenly realized the greatness, truth and tremendous vitality of the original ideas and leadership of Kim Jong Un who is accelerating the building of a highly civilized and prospering state through new qualitative changes in regional areas.

The inaugural ceremony of the Kusong City Hospital, which significantly adorns the first year of the historic public health revolution, marked a significant occasion in giving full play to the sky-high spirit and enthusiasm of all the people across the country who are single-mindedly striving to successfully conclude the first-stage pioneering struggle for changes towards the comprehensive development of socialism and greet the Ninth Congress of the WPK as the one of victors and glory. -0-

ab10bc0e7ba10530fd873d60137e1af4.title: Inauguration Ceremony of Regional-industry Factories and Leisure Complex Held with Splendor in Kangdong County
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 16 (KCNA) -- The Workers' Party of Korea is accelerating the accomplishment of the epoch-making cause of reconstructing the regional economy completely based on new foundations, taking steps towards the comprehensive prosperity of Korean-style socialism in a responsible manner. Kangdong County greeted the day of inaugurating its regional-industry factories and leisure complex, adding to the joy of the second inauguration season in implementing the regional development policy which has come without delay thanks to the Party's guidance.

The modern light industry factories and multifunctional bases for cultural life, built in 20 cities and counties after seeing the exciting explosions in their ground-breaking ceremonies with the great joy, redoubled self-confidence and high spirit provided through the creative struggle in the first year for regional transformation, are significantly decorating the closing days of the historic year 2025, demonstrating the definite trend of the irreversible change and development.
An inauguration ceremony of regional-industry factories and leisure complex in Kangdong County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy was held with splendor on December 15.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.
When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!".

They extended the highest respect and glory to Kim Jong Un who is ushering in a heyday of changes, in which the outcomes of the gigantic revolution settle in the people's living as dear things as soon as possible, after setting the implementation of the regional development policy in the new era as a solemn oath and pledge the WPK made before the country and the people.

Present at the ceremony were senior officials of the Party, government and military organs, members of the Party central leadership body in Pyongyang, chief secretaries of the provincial Party committees, officials of the Party and power organs in Pyongyang and Kangdong County, working people and officers and men of the construction units.
Ri Il Hwan, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, made an inauguration address.

The speaker said with excitement that another splendid inauguration ceremony is being held in Kangdong County, where the start of the grand construction in 2025 was declared and the first modern regional hospital was built.

He said that those factories and leisure complex are the precious assets brought by the energetic leadership of Kim Jong Un who dug the first spadeful of earth to signal the start of the projects at the groundbreaking ceremony and visited the construction sites several times to guide and take care of them. And he warmly congratulated the people of Kangdong County who would enjoy a new beautiful and civilized life under the warm blessing of the great father.

The speaker also extended warm thanks and encouragement to the soldier-builders and the officials and workers in the relevant sector, who successfully carried out the projects for regional development policy, always remembering the great trust of the Party which made them stand in the vanguard of the struggle for the regional development, and made positive contributions to the construction with a high sense of responsibility for implementing the Party's decision.

It is the consistent goal of Kim Jong Un's policy on regional construction to make a nonstop leap forward with the passage of years in promoting the people's well-being and to orient and expand this undertaking in the direction of providing them with all the elements necessary for promoting the regional development and improving the people's living standards, he said, referring to the fact that Kim Jong Un energetically led the construction of the light industrial factories and leisure complexes conducive to the improvement of the regional people's material life and their moral and cultural development so that they would be perfectly built as a symbol of our own style of civilization and development.

He stressed that the eye-opening changes in Kangdong County, where a modern hospital, regional-industry factories and leisure complex have been built at the same time in less than a year, would tell forever the greatness and tremendous vitality of our Party's regional development policy along with the appearance of the happy people enjoying a civilized and wealthy life.

The epoch-making cause of fundamentally transforming the local areas is entering an orbit of overall expansion amid the succession of groundbreaking and inauguration ceremonies every year, the speaker said, ardently calling upon all to think and act in accordance with the great patriotic will of Kim Jong Un and devote wisdom, strength and enthusiasm to the prosperity of the country.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.

A large number of balloons rose up and fireworks were displayed over the venue of the inauguration ceremony overflowing with great emotion of the residents in Kangdong County who were significantly celebrating another auspicious event, to be specially recorded in the development history of the county, in the presence of the benevolent father of the large socialist family in their native place.

All the participants extended their boundless gratitude to the great artist of creation and construction and the outstanding leader of the people who is glorifying the annals of great changes for the regional development in the new era.
Kim Jong Un went round the Kangdong County Foodstuff Factory and the Leisure Complex.

Expressing his surging emotion of witnessing the worthwhile struggle targeting the great changes across the country undergoing another proud process amid the full support of the people, Kim Jong Un said that to achieve a leap forward in the local areas and provide the people with precious entities of prosperity and civilization are a sacred undertaking which our Party serving the people should unconditionally and consistently push ahead without a moment's stagnation or delay.

The true value of the regional-industry revolution should be verified not only in creating material wealth but also in transforming the ideological consciousness of officials and working people in keeping with the demand of the new era, he said, adding that the spirit and fighting principle of upholding the Party's policies should remain unchanged but the goal and sphere of creation should be steadily updated and improved.

Saying that the regional people are the beneficiaries and enjoyers of the regional development policy in the new era, Kim Jong Un stressed the need to invariably preserve and glorify the true nature of Korean-style socialism where the Party policy is mapped out for the people and the people enjoy happiness to their heart's content thanks to it.

As the valuable successes and experience increase and the people's dreams and ideals grow higher, our Party will lead to endless upswing and expansion the era of dynamic movement beyond all precedents and limits in terms of speed of advance and changes for the national rejuvenation and breadth and depth of innovation and creation with its stronger will and strenuous efforts, he stressed.

The participants in the inauguration ceremony went round factories put on a modern, economic profitable and long-term basis to suit the regional situation and the Leisure Complex which will promote the cultural life of the regional people, delightedly sharing with each other about impressions on new life, new civilization and new wellbeing.

The grand inauguration of the regional industrial factories and the leisure complex in Kangdong County serves as another significant occasion in greatly increasing the joy and patriotic enthusiasm of the people across the country who are advancing towards the Ninth Congress of the WPK amid firework display celebrating the successes in implementing the regional development revolution. -0-

db87eec0a800c63405dcfde4f9fd8715.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of Sun
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 17 (KCNA) -- All the people and service personnel across the DPRK pay the highest tribute, with boundless yearning and ardent loyalty, to Chairman Kim Jong Il, looking back with deep emotion on the sacred revolutionary career and eternal exploits of the peerlessly great man, who set it as his lifelong cause to build on this land a country which will always be powerful and prosperous and devoted his all to its realization, on the occasion of the 14th anniversary of his demise.

Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun at 00:00 on December 17, the greatest memorial day for our Party, state and people.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was accompanied by members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee and other senior officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and officials of the WPK Central Committee, leading officials of the Cabinet, commissions, ministries and national agencies, the commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and the commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army.
Flower baskets were laid before the statues of President Kim Il Sung and Chairman Kim Jong Il.
Kim Jong Un, together with other visitors, bowed before the statues as an expression of noble respects to the great leaders.
At the hall, where the Chairman lies in state, Kim Jong Un, together with other visitors, paid high tribute to him, praying for his immortality.

All the visitors made a firm pledge to remain true, with their whole heart and loyalty, to the ideology and leadership of Kim Jong Un who is glorifying the patriotic exploits of Kim Jong Il by opening up a new glorious history of comprehensive national rejuvenation. -0-

f5e0de65190da3a5e8bc477e24e866ed.title: Regional-industry Factories in Jangyon County Inaugurated with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 19 (KCNA) -- Edifices symbolic of the era are springing up in different parts of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) to demonstrate its power for great progress toward comprehensive development of socialist construction. The endless laughter of its citizens, excited at this epoch-making transformation, further highlights the truthfulness and vitality of the regional development policy of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK).
Regional-industry factories newly built under the Regional Development 20×10 Policy were inaugurated with a splendid ceremony in Jangyon County on Dec. 18.

The venue for the inauguration ceremony were filled with boundless gratitude and absolute trust in the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who opened up a bright prospect for building ideal socialist society, where all the people across the country enjoy new richer, happier and highly civilized life, and is translating it into present reality with his determined efforts.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the DPRK, attended the inauguration ceremony.
When he arrived at the venue, all the participants broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!"

They extended the highest respect to the outstanding leader of the revolution and the benevolent father of the people, who is adorning every year on this land with gigantic changes through his days and months filled with his fervent love and devotion for the people.

Present at the ceremony were leading officials of the WPK Central Committee, chief secretaries of the provincial committees of the WPK, commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK and large combined units of the Korean People's Army, officials of South Hwanghae Province and the county, working people and soldier-builders.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, addressed the ceremony.

The speaker warmly congratulated all the citizens in the county on holding a significant ceremony of inaugurating the new light industrial factories assuring them of their hometown's rosy future in the presence of Kim Jong Un, saying that the auspicious season of industrial factories' inauguration for successfully concluding this year, throughout which dynamic regional transformation has been pushed forward, has arrived in Jangyon County, too.

He also extended thanks to the soldier-builders, officials, workers, scientists and technicians in the relevant sector who added a new page of fresh transformation to the sacred history of regional development through an indomitable campaign.

Saying that the strong trend of the great era is rapidly transforming the whole country, he noted that modern hospitals, leisure complexes and other entities of transformation that match those in the capital city are being erected in cities and counties, and it is a remarkable change brought about by the noble intention and untiring efforts of Kim Jong Un to make the people more keenly realize in their daily life the advantages of their state system guided by the people-first principle through thoroughgoing and successful implementation of the regional development strategy.

Recalling that Kim Jong Un, who indicated the concrete orientation, tasks and methodologies for successfully carrying out the gigantic revolutionary undertaking to eliminate the centuries-old backwardness of the regions and realize the cherished desire of the regional citizens, has made sure that the yearly construction processes serve as leaps forward to a higher stage, the speaker said that under his outstanding leadership, one-tenth of the regions came to have the solid foundation for independent development last year and one-fifth of them this year already.

New structures, including a modern hospital and leisure complex, will be built in Jangyon County in the future as part of the efforts for implementing the regional development policy that are expanding year by year, he said, adding that the county should set much store by the assets of high civilization provided by the new era, push ahead with the undertakings for regional development on this basis and thus make more significant progress in improving the living standards of the county citizens.

He ardently called for remaining loyal to the ideas and leadership of Kim Jong Un and waging more dynamic struggle for the steady implementation of the regional development policy and the future of the country which will be highly civilized and prosperous.
Kim Jong Un cut the inaugural tape.

At the venue of the inauguration ceremony, which witnessed the exciting moments to be eternally recorded in the history of the country along with the new era of regional development, fireworks of celebration were let off and a great number of balloons flied up into the sky over the county.

All the participants fervently cheered, so excited to have the great honor of celebrating with splendor the day of inauguration in the presence of Kim Jong Un whom they have longed to see even in their dreams.
A child presented a bouquet of fragrant flowers to Kim Jong Un in reflection of the county citizens' unanimous reverence for him.
Kim Jong Un met some working people participating in the inauguration ceremony and shook hands with them one by one, warmly wishing them a happy future.
He went round the regional-industry factories.

He said that in the course of undergoing a significant change in the second year for bringing about a radical transformation in the regions and improving the living standards of the people across the country, we further hardened the belief that when we strenuously explore the path toward development and prosperity in our own way and make courageous efforts under the uplifted banner of self-reliance, there will be no unachievable ideal and a socialist paradise can be surely built on this land.

It is the desire of our Party and the primary goal of its regional development policy to turn all cities and counties of the country into self-supporting and well-off ones by firmly consolidating the foundation of regional development and radically improving the material and cultural living standards of the regional people, he added.
Tasting products of the county foodstuff factory, including wheat paste and sauce, he expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the factory attaches great importance to the quality of products.

Saying it is really spectacular to see the foodstuff factory making products with a local brand through an advanced beer production line, he stressed that it is the correct implementation of the Party policies and the further development to increase the indices of production conducive to improving the material life of the residents in the county with raw materials abundant in the region and bring out excellent products.

Saying that the taste and quality of products depend on the sincerity and skill of producers, he called for compiling the guidelines on the detailed quality indices and standard operation for every process, ranging from the sorting of raw materials to the shipping of products, and establishing a system for strictly observing them. At the same time, it is necessary to organize a brisk competition for developing new products and improving quality among the newly-built regional-industry factories in order to create and improve the atmosphere of advancing and developing all together, he said.
