Saying that it is noticeable that progress has been made in a different fashion this year, when compared to last year, in architectural design, technical aspects of construction and indices of products, and that if we make strenuous efforts to attain the far-reaching ideal and high goal, the vitality of the regional development policy will get stronger with each passing year, he clarified some important tasks arising in building regional-industry factories next year and promoting the independence of provinces, cities and counties.

Highly appreciating the steadfast patriotic loyalty of all officers and men of the 124th regiments at different levels of the Korean People's Army, he expressed expectation and belief that they would successfully carry out the further expanded projects for regional development policy on the basis of the potentials and experience they gained through the construction of last year and this year.

Kim Jong Un earnestly asked the officials of Jangyon County and employees of the regional-industry factories to keep the production going at a high rate, mindful that to make the county citizens well off is just meant to live up to the benevolence of the Party.

Seeing the county citizens being pleased with various kinds of condiments, confectionery, daily necessities and clothes with county brands, the leading officials more keenly realized that Kim Jong Un's devoted efforts bring about the happiness of people and hasten the bright future of the prospering country.

The successive inauguration of regional-industry factories, the precious fruition of the people-first politics of the great WPK, is greatly encouraging the people across the country going all out in the patriotic advance for creation toward the glorious Party Congress with firm confidence in their cause and ideal. -0-

427cbf7df907796c38b953edd5269c88.title: Regional-Industry Factories Inaugurated with Splendor in Sinpho City of DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 21 (KCNA) -- The great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee is bringing earlier the eye-opening future of the comprehensive development of socialism through the epochal transformation of the whole country. Thanks to its dynamic and powerful leadership ability, a worthy and stirring era unprecedented in the history is being ushered in on this land.

The modern light industrial factories perfectly built this year in Sinpho City of South Hamgyong Province, which witnessed the completion of a new offshore farm last year, greeted the significant moment of their inauguration.

It signifies the establishment of another reliable material foundation, which will contribute to enabling the local people to lead a more affluent life, in the historic place, the venue of a consultative meeting on the development of the regional economy which was recorded as a Changsong Joint Conference of today in the history of the Korean revolution. This striking reality is a successful result of the unique state-building idea and energetic leadership of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who is making ceaseless efforts to develop all the cities and counties across the country into the civilized and prosperous regional hubs.
The inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories in Sinpho City for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy was held with splendor on December 19.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.

When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue of the ceremony, all the participants raised stormy cheers of "Hurrah!", in reflection of their great emotion and delight of being honored to have him, the great father of the large family of the whole country who is translating all dreams and ideals of the people into reality of the present times, in their place again.

Present at the ceremony were members of the central leadership organ of the Party, commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army, officials in South Hamgyong Province and Sinpho City, working people, soldier-builders and employees of the factories.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, addressed the ceremony.

Saying that the coastal area of the East Sea is also overflowing with joy over the completion of modern regional-industry factories in different parts of the country, which highlights the historic significance of 2025, the year of great transformation, the speaker congratulated the residents in Sinpho City on greeting the moment of glory today again in the wake of the splendid inauguration ceremony of an offshore farm held in the presence of Kim Jong Un a year ago.

As witnessed by history, the current transformation is precious fruition of the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un who indicated the path and ways for Sinpho City to achieve development and prosperity with its own resources and took all measures to do so, he said.

He told in an excited tone about the devoted efforts of Kim Jong Un who led Sinpho City step by step to turn it into a comprehensive industrial zone capable of making effective use of marine resources, saying that the Party's regional development policy should not go merely for symbolic sake but should be for radically improving the living conditions of the local people and promoting the peculiar development of the regions.

Recalling that 40 cities and counties have already laid the foundation for independent development in the second year as a result of the ongoing accelerated cause of transforming the whole country, he stressed that it is a striking demonstration of the truthfulness, inexhaustible might and bright prospect of our Party's regional development policy set forth and being guided by Kim Jong Un.

When we continue to follow the course of bold creation and advance, valuing the precious fruits of the stubborn struggle, our strength will grow stronger and the goal of comprehensive rejuvenation, in which all cities and counties undergo transformation and development in a balanced way, will surely be attained earlier, he said, ardently calling upon all to dedicate themselves to bringing about the prosperity of our beloved motherland, more highly civilized and beautiful life, and a bright future of the rising generations, with their single-minded patriotism.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.
The cheers of excitement resounded throughout the venue for the inauguration ceremony and fireworks were set off with many balloons rising up into the sky.

The residents of Sinpho City extended thanks to Kim Jong Un for repeatedly visiting their hometown, leaving the traces of his great guidance, to enable them to enjoy benefits from the regional-industry revolution earlier than others, and for showing his great benevolence for them once again as if it fell short of their expectations.
Lovely children presented Kim Jong Un with bouquets of fragrant flowers reflecting the unanimous wishes of the residents.
Kim Jong Un waved back to the enthusiastically cheering participants and warmly wished the city a bright future when it would be richer along with the history of the steady regional transformation.

He met commanding officers of the unit involved in the construction of the regional-industry factories in Sinpho City and encouraged all the officers and men of the unit who successfully built reliable production bases conducive to improving the regional people's living standards through their vanguard role in ushering in the era of regional transformation.
He went round the Phungo Shop and the Sinpho City Foodstuff Factory.

Looking at the products produced by regional-industry factories, he said that Sinpho City has now reliable potential and strong driving force for its independent development and that the Phungo-dong area has turned into a centre for regional economic development and a powerful base for improving the people's standard of living.

He reaffirmed the will and determination of the WPK to set a higher goal of regional development and further lengthen the stride for progress to unconditionally carry it out without an inch of deflection.

Going round various production rooms of the foodstuff factory, he said that it is important for the regional-industry factories recently built to exchange with each another their experience gained in production and generalize the advantages so as to positively inspire the light industrial production bases across the country to develop together.

He requested the officials of Sinpho City and employees of the regional-industry factories to steadily and persistently push ahead with the work for the normal operation and increased production of the light industrial bases in the spirit of devoted service for the people in order to make sure that the vitality of our Party's policy leads to the promotion of the well-being of the regional people.
Then he visited the Sinpho City Offshore Farm.
He learned in detail about its aquiculture and processing process.
He expressed his great satisfaction, seeing every freezing chamber fully loaded with products.

Recollecting with deep emotion the time when he had a consultative meeting on the development of the regional economy in this place, which had only a pine forest and sandy beach in July of 2024, he noted with pleasure that the aquaculture base, which has entered the track of steady development in a matter of one and a half years, produces marine products on a regular basis and the light industrial bases of the city have a strong developmental potential for producing various kinds of processed seafood and daily necessities at their will.

Saying that the vitality of the Party's policy which has proved to be effective in reality makes us to harden our will to go along the road chosen by ourselves to the end with the pride of making a proper decision, he affirmed that our ideal, will and efforts reflected in our every step will surely bring earlier the prosperous future when all the people across the country will lead a happy life together.

He hoped Sinpho City, which is covering the course of development as a model for the cities and counties in the coastal areas of the DPRK, would be well known as a highly civilized and rich city which creates a new history of prosperity with confidence, relying on its independent foundation.

Thanks to Kim Jong Un, who regards the people as Heaven and unconditionally subordinates everything to the people's wellbeing, our cause advancing with the most just and far-reaching ambition will be invincible forever and the happy laughter of the people will resound century after century along with the wealth of prosperity rising up across the country. -0-

1a9b265adf39838404115c2e924adb4b.title: New Hotels Inaugurated in Samjiyon Tourist Resort of DPRK
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 23 (KCNA) -- Thanks to the direct initiative and energetic leadership of the great Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee, modern hotels have been newly built and inaugurated in Samjiyon City, whose attractive appearance undergoes a better transformation as a typical mountainous city in the northern part of the DPRK and a unique all-season mountainous tourist resort.

The hotels, built to exhibit special architectural beauty and provide peculiar service in good harmony with the magnificence of nature in the Mt Paektu area, along with the symbolic names peculiar to the Samjiyon area such as Sobaeksu, Ikal, Potnamu and Chongbong, are the proud creations of our era when a new phase has been opened up in building public service centres in all aspects of contents and forms.
Inauguration ceremonies of five hotels newly built in the Samjiyon Tourist Resort took place on December 20 and 21.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un attended the inauguration ceremony of the Ikal and Milyong hotels on Dec. 20.

When he arrived, all the participants raised stormy cheers as a token of their great reverence for him who is bringing earlier the rosy future of Korean-style socialism with his untiring thought and devotion out of his fervent desire to make our people the most dignified who have nothing to envy in the world.
Present at the ceremonies were officials of ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, officials in Samjiyon City and employees of the hotels.
Speeches were made at the ceremonies.

Referring to the painstaking efforts made by Kim Jong Un to bring about a great transformation in the Paektu area, where beautiful scenes, indescribable with the mysterious sceneries of nature only, are being witnessed, the speakers said that the hotels are the meaningful creations heralding the emergence of a large tourist zone covering Mt Paektu, Mt Pukphothae and Mt Namphothae.
Expressing belief that Samjiyon City will soon be renowned as an attractive mountainous tourist resort and leisure ground for the people, they declared the completion of the hotels.
Ceremonial services were given to commemorate the inauguration of the hotels.
Kim Jong Un, together with the participants, went round the hotels.

Going round bedrooms of hotels, cosy leisure spaces and commercial and public catering facilities, he appreciated that all elements are at a high level in terms of practicality, diversity and formative art to preserve their own attractiveness.
He said that he was pleased to see such wonderful public service facilities built in Samjiyon City.

Referring to the importance of the hotels' position and role in creating the culture of tourism in the country and promoting tourism, he said that service facilities are important in developing tourism, but the main thing is the quality of service. He called for directing primary efforts to improving the service capacity and professional qualifications of service workers in hotels.

To this end, it arises as an essential requirement to further expand and strengthen the national system of training professional service workers, he said, stressing the need to proactively develop new service industries capable of fully satisfying the customers' different demands.

He expressed his unshakable will to turn Samjiyon City better into an innovative and highly civilized city representing the tourism culture of the country, noting that to build the entities of modern civilization in tourist attractions on a large scale, along with the on-going new history of radical development and transformation in different parts of the capital and the regions, is just a clear proof of the ever-growing ideal of our people and our state's potential for development.
Expressing expectation and belief that the officials and employees of the hotels would achieve successes in their work, he wished the hotels prosperity.
Inauguration ceremonies of the Sobaeksu Hotel, Chongbong Hotel and the Potnamu Hotel took place on December 21.

The participants in the ceremonies went round smart rooms satisfying various tastes of guests, different service facilities providing abundant cultural living environments, indoor and outdoor spas arousing sweet feelings and fresh vitality in all seasons and other parts of the hotels.

They deeply realized the eye-opening reality of the country which is undergoing transformation with each passing year thanks to the noble intention and determined efforts of Kim Jong Un, who is absolutely subordinating everything to the sake of the people, and the new vibrant civilization coming closer to the people's life.

The completion of modern hotels demonstrating the dynamic changes in Samjiyon City vividly shows the high spirit of our state, which is advancing steadily toward a high stage of comprehensive prosperity and development under the great leadership of Kim Jong Un, and the bright prospect of the Mt Paektu area which will shine more brilliantly as a world-renowned scenic spot. -0-

1e39baf5ddbc9eb15fcc275235721bc2.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Guides Building of Nuclear-powered Strategic Guided Missile Submarine
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, guided the building of an 8 700-tonnage nuclear-powered strategic guided missile submarine on the spot.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was accompanied by leading officials in the sectors of the warship-building industry and the defence science research and production.
Kim Jong Un went round the site of building the nuclear-powered submarine and received a report on its progress.

Workers, scientists and technicians in the warship-building field, all out in the glorious struggle for implementing the WPK's policy of modernizing the navy, are pushing ahead with the building of a strategic nuclear attack submarine, one of the five-point major tasks for developing the defence capabilities set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK, by fully displaying the great power of self-reliance and inexhaustible patriotic enthusiasm.

Kim Jong Un stressed once again the importance and significance of building a strategic nuclear attack submarine in carrying out the self-reliant defence policy of the WPK and the government of the DPRK.

Noting that our defence policy is literally a defensive policy based on the strongest offensive power, he said that to this end, we regard the super-powerful offensive capability as the best shield for national security in developing the armed forces.

Saying that it is the noble mission and duty of the current generation to further strengthen the nuclear shield that represents the prestige and honour of the DPRK and absolutely guarantees its security and to consolidate the irreversible position, he stressed that the WPK and the government of the DPRK will remain unchanged in their determination to permanently ensure the peaceful environment and absolute security of the country by composing the nuclear forces that the enemy can't help fearing.

We have built in every way the nuclear shield capable of reliably defending our national security and secured the capability for expanding it to the extent necessary for ensuring the national security environment, he said, adding that the completion of a new nuclear submarine will serve as an epoch-making crucial change that further assures ourselves and even the enemy of the war deterrent level the DPRK has reached. He clarified the steadfast will and the strategic and tactical policy to steadily push forward with the nuclear weaponization of the navy.

The Party Central Committee is pleased to see the warship-building sector achieving signal production successes, true to the WPK's line of building up the naval force in the new century, he said, adding that the strategic nuclear attack submarine to be considered as an important component of the nuclear war deterrent will constitute the greatest immortal feats of the working class, defence scientists and technicians, the driving force of the DPRK, for the times and history.

He affirmed that the present world is by no means peaceful and such situation and the prospective threats to be posed highlight undoubtedly the decision made by the DPRK with regard to the future security of the country as the most just option and the manifestation of its will to safeguard its sovereignty and interests in a responsible manner.

Saying that the nuclear submarine development plan of the ROK, which Washington has agreed on at the solicitation of Seoul recently, will worsen the instability in the region of the Korean peninsula, he stressed that the DPRK regards it as an offensive act severely violating its security and maritime sovereignty and a threat to its security that must be countered.

Given the negative security situation that has come as present reality only, it is an urgent task and indispensable option to further accelerate the radical development of the modernization and nuclear weaponization of the naval force of the DPRK, he said.

Attack destroyers and nuclear submarines recently under construction will make a leap forward in bolstering up the combat capabilities of our fleets and contribute to defending the strategic sovereignty and security of our country, he said, adding that the DPRK will develop the navy and its strategic components in a constant and diverse way, steadily increase and expand the speed and scale of building various surface and underwater warships and continuously equip them with different offensive weapon systems.

Noting that the WPK and the DPRK government will stay definitely unchanged in their national security policy and their principle of deterring the enemy, he said it is needed to make the enemy understand with no doubt that they will be surely forced to pay a dear price when they violate the security of the DPRK's strategic sovereignty and that they will face a merciless retaliatory attack if they try to select a military option. The DPRK will continue to show such capabilities and this goes just as the responsible exercise of the true nuclear war deterrent and a reliable shield for defending sovereignty, he added.

That day, he learned in detail about the on-going research on the new underwater secret weapons under development and clarified a strategic plan for reorganizing the naval forces and establishing new units. -0-

6ec718a59b27e8882f3a67f0edb73316.title: Regional-industry Factories and Leisure Complex Inaugurated with Splendour in Jongphyong County
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- Now that the whole country is pulsating with excitement at great transformation and fresh hope, an inauguration ceremony of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex, newly built in Jongphyong County for the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, took place with splendour on December 24.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.
When he arrived at the venue for the ceremony, the participants raised deafening cheers with reverence for the great leader of the people.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un received a report on the completion of the project from the commanding officer of the military unit involved in the construction of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex in the county.

Present at the ceremony were members of the central leadership body of the WPK, commanding officers of the large combined units of the Korean People's Army, officials and working people in South Hamgyong Province and Jongphyong County, soldier-builders and employees of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, addressed the ceremony.

Saying the joy of great transformation in the new era of regional construction has also come to Jongphyong County, the speaker warmly congratulated the county citizens on the better life and new culture they will lead with the inauguration of modern regional-industry factories and leisure complex.

Thanks to the noble intention and sincerity of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un that the people's wish is the wish of the Party and the struggle for bringing wellbeing earlier to the people should be intensified nonstop, the construction of regional light industrial factories, the level of which are as good as those in the capital city, has been pushed forward at the state expense, and the regional-industry factories, which are more advanced than those built last year, have appeared in 20 cities and counties across the country, he said.

He noted that the leisure complex in the county is a valuable creation embodying the high intention of Kim Jong Un to bring about a sure change in the cultural progress of the regions by providing the conditions for enjoying advanced civilization not only in material life but also in all aspects of mental and cultural life.

The speaker expressed belief that the officers and men of the construction units, who successfully built the regional-industry factories and leisure complex in Jongphyong County in the high revolutionary spirit peculiar to the People's Army remaining absolutely loyal to the order of the Party and earnest in fulfilling its desire, would perform brilliant feats in every site of the further expanded regional construction under the uplifted glorious colors of theirs.
Kim Jong Un unveiled the monument to the inauguration of the regional-industry factories and leisure complex.
Lovely children presented him with bouquets of fragrant flowers reflecting the unanimous gratitude of the county citizens.

Kim Jong Un met some working people in the county and commanding officers of the construction units who participated in the inauguration ceremony, and shook hands with them one by one as a token of his warm encouragement.
He went round the leisure complex.

Going round various parts of the library and the general commercial district, he stressed the need to run and manage the complex effectively as befitting its characteristics as a public leisure centre for improving the regional cultures of life, study and commerce and training the regional citizens to be pioneers and creators of new culture.

Saying that the true significance of the regional revolution lies in raising the people's ideological consciousness and cultural level to the one corresponding to the new era and continuously setting higher goals and levels of creation, he clarified a series of tasks related to the next year's construction of leisure complexes in 20 cities and counties.
Then he visited the regional-industry factories.
There was an inauguration ceremony.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.
He visited the Jongphyong County Foodstuff Factory.

When deciding on the Regional Development 20×10 Policy, there were certainly some individuals being skeptical about its implementation even among cadres as the plan for regional development was largest ever in its scale, but not only those cadres but also all our people are now convinced of the validity of the Party policy, practical power for its implementation and its bright future, witnessing the domains of construction further expanding with each passing year and the inauguration season which has come without fail this year like last year.

He said that the popular masses' deeper trust in the Party and absolute confidence in its policy are, indeed, the greatest success registered in the struggle of two years for bringing about fundamental changes in the regions.

He earnestly requested the officials and employees of the regional-industry factories to regard the people's demands and evaluation as an absolute criterion and conduct management and operation in a responsible manner so as to keep the production going at a high rate.

He sincerely hoped that the new leisure complex and regional-industry factories in the county would make a substantial contribution to the economic development of the county and improvement of the living standards of its citizens. -0-

87a1b9c250c0beef0656b59c2d48107b.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Observes Test-fire of New-type Anti-Air Missiles
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 25 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, observed a test-fire of new-type anti-air missiles.
The Missile Administration of the DPRK conducted a test-fire of new-type high-altitude long-range anti-air missiles under development in the East Sea of Korea on December 24.
This is the first test-fire for estimating the tactical and technical features of the high-altitude long-range anti-air missile system in development.
The launched missiles accurately hit the mock targets at an altitude of 200 km.

The test-fire is a part of the routine activities of the Missile Administration and its affiliated anti-air weapon system research institutes for the technical optimization of the national anti-air defence means.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un extended congratulations on the successful test-fire. -0-

bd08ee3950289713c791451237477f13.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Major Munitions Industry Enterprises
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 26 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, visited major munitions industry enterprises to acquaint himself with the missile and shell production in the fourth quarter of this year.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the Central Committee of the WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, leading officials in the defence science research field and managers of major munitions industry enterprises.
Kim Jong Un received a report on the achievements of the missile and shell production sector in 2025 and the production in the fourth quarter.

He underlined the need to work out the production plan for 2026 in a development-oriented way to meet the prospective requirements in the operation of the state missile and artillery forces. Saying to that end, it is necessary to reinforce the technical foundations of the relevant production enterprises in a balanced way to further expand the overall production capacity, he clarified the technical and economic tasks for doing so.

He highly appreciated that major munitions industry enterprises successfully fulfilled their production plans for 2025, the last year for implementing the five-year plan set forth at the 8th Congress of the WPK, and made a pivotal and core contribution to implementing the plan for developing the defence capabilities in the period under review.

In order to satisfy the prospective demands of the missile and artillery forces of the Korean People's Army, it is necessary to continuously raise the level of modernization of the munitions industry by establishing new munitions industry enterprises as planned, the construction of which will be decided on at the 9th Congress of the WPK, and steadily updating the production structure of the existing factories in a more efficient and practical way, he said.

Saying that in particular, the missile and shell production sector is of paramount importance in bolstering up the war deterrent, he stressed that the Missile Administration of the DPRK and the relevant general bureau of the Second Economy Commission should make thorough preparations for unconditionally accepting and carrying out in a responsible manner the new modernization and production plans to be set forth at the 9th Congress of the WPK.
That day, he ratified the draft documents for modernization plan of major munitions industry enterprises to be submitted to the 9th Congress of the WPK. -0-

97ac4334bcdf54eebee5ae08fe73a499.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets with Labor Innovators and Meritorious Persons
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, met and had a photo session with labor innovators and meritorious persons invited to the celebrations of Constitution Day of the DPRK and the New Year at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Dec. 27.
When the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un appeared at the venue for the photo session, stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" shook the venue.

All the participants were greatly excited to meet Kim Jong Un on the platform of dream-like happiness with great pride and honor of being the labor innovators and meritorious persons representing the victorious and glorious year of 2025.

Kim Jong Un expressed thanks to the patriotic devotion of the labor innovators and meritorious persons, as a token of his warm encouragement to them, for making contributions to glorifying the significant year of 2025 as the one of a great turn to be specially recorded in the history of the development of the Republic by dedicating their pure conscience to the rejuvenation and prosperity of the country.

He said that the country is prospering and our cause is dynamically advancing without a moment's stagnation, thanks to the well-known and unsung patriots who devote their diligent and sincere efforts to the work at their workplaces and posts, placing their obligations above the rights of citizens granted by the Constitution of the DPRK.

Saying that the Party and the government firmly believe in and exclusively rely on high patriotic enthusiasm of the people in the historic struggle for the overall development of socialist construction, he expressed expectation and belief that the participants would continue to creditably play their role as the vanguard and standard-bearers of the times, and had a photo session with them.
He met the women footballers and coaches who won the first place in the 2025 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup, and had a photo taken with them, wishing them greater successes in the future.
When the photo session was over, the participants broke into enthusiastic cheers again.
They vowed to firmly trust and follow the WPK single-mindedly and devote their all to the prosperity of the DPRK, regarding the great love and trust shown by him as their eternal lifeblood. -0-

f62e66ad9ff89ba76111a52c7a18968e.title: National Flag-raising and Oath-taking Ceremony Held to Mark Constitution Day
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 28 (KCNA) -- A national flag-raising and oath-taking ceremony took place at the Mansudae Assembly Hall on Dec. 27 to mark Constitution Day of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, amid the struggle of the year 2025 for the country's comprehensive prosperity and development which has resulted in signal successes and patriotic enthusiasm of all the people remarkably soaring to greet the Ninth Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea as the one of victory and glory.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the commemorative event.

Present there were members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the WPK and other leading officials of the Party and the government, officials of the Party Central Committee, senior officials of the Cabinet, ministries, national agencies and armed forces organs, officials of judicial and public prosecutors offices and those of power organs in Pyongyang Municipality.
The guard of honor of the Korean People's Army lined up at the venue for the commemorative ceremony.
A ceremony of hoisting the national flag of the DPRK took place.
Members of the guard of honor of the KPA solemnly escorted the national flag of the DPRK to the venue for the ceremony.

All the participants paid high tribute to the national flag associated with the history of heroic struggle and the brave spirit of Juche Korea, which has firmly defended the dignity and honour of the country and the people and brought about the era of great changes by holding fast to the genuine people's code, the great political constitution, as a powerful weapon for the state development and invariably embodying its noble principles and ideals.
The glorious national flag was hoisted.

The venue was full of ardent desire to devote all wisdom and enthusiasm to the glorious and worthwhile struggle for the prosperity of the country in the stirring era when the great ambition and strong aspiration to lead the whole world by dint of the iron will fostered by the truth are being translated into reality.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a commemorative oath to mark Constitution Day of the DPRK.

Led by the head of state, the participants solemnly vowed before the national flag to dedicate themselves to glorifying forever the greatness and beauty of the country by always remaining faithful to promoting the people's well-being and the growth and development of the state, thoroughly defending the Constitution of the Republic, strictly carrying on their legal obligations, firmly defending the socialist ideal and system and staying faithful to the beloved motherland as responsible members who defend the sovereignty of the DPRK and the interests of the Korean people and serve the state and the people.

All the participants were full of enthusiasm to fully discharge their responsibility and duty entrusted by the people on the forefront of implementing the historic sacred cause so as to legally and firmly guarantee the comprehensive rejuvenation and development of our state by applying the original idea of the great Comrade Kim Jong Un on establishing the people-first law and to consolidate the country into a socialist paradise, where the ideal of the people has been realized, and into an invincible fortress that no one in the world dares provoke. -0-

2914094139f88cd76b38dc2a851f11e3.title: Unsan Paper Mill Inaugurated in South Phyongan Province
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 29 (KCNA) -- At the time when the cheers of inaugurations celebrating the steady achievements of the regional development policy are stirring up the whole country with the exciting echoes in 2025, a modern paper mill was built in South Phyongan Province to greet the auspicious event of inauguration pioneering another new sphere for putting the regional industry on an advanced basis.

The paper mill, which has been built in Unsan County of South Phyongan Province as a model one according to the Workers' Party of Korea's decision to build a paper production base in all provinces capable of satisfying their demand, will mass-produce paper for writing, packing and toilet and other paper products.
The paper mill, built in Unsan County of South Phyongan Province, was inaugurated with due ceremony on Dec. 28.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.

All the participants paid the highest tribute to the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un who came with warm blessings regarding the creations to contribute to improving the people's wellbeing as the most precious wealth.

Present at the ceremony were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and other members of the central leadership body of the Party, officials of ministries and national agencies, officials of South Phyongan Province and Unsan County, working people, employees of the mill and scientists and technicians of the State Academy of Sciences.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, delivered an inaugural address.

He warmly congratulated the scientists and technicians, builders of the province and workers of various enterprises on having successfully built the mill of weighty significance in developing the paper industry of Korean style and satisfying the country's long-term demand for paper.

He said that under the wise leadership of Kim Jong Un, who gave detailed guidance to the design and layouts of the structure and sent sci-tech force so that the professional and functional character as a paper production mill was ensured, the construction of the Unsan Paper Mill had been pushed forward with confidence from the beginning and it took on full appearance as a comprehensive production base.

The speaker noted that Kim Jong Un visited the mill ahead of its inauguration to encourage and highly appreciate the scientists and technicians for contributing to the development of paper industry of the country and stressed the need to steadily develop the papermaking method and technology of Korean style, adding that his instructions served as an important guideline for putting the paper industry on a definite development stage.

He said that the officials and working people in the province, entrusted with a task for building a paper mill by the Party, dynamically launched the collective innovation movement to finish the construction work in a qualitative way and manufacture and install a lot of equipment, thus creating a model for the whole country in implementing the Party's policy on developing the regions and improving the people's living standards under the uplifted banner of self-reliance. He also noted that our scientists and technicians have achieved proud successes in establishing a new paper production technology, which the Party attaches importance to, with the extraordinary pioneering spirit and enthusiasm for creation.

The speaker called for continuously making strenuous efforts to successfully carry out the regional revolution most urgent in improving the people's standard of living and realizing the comprehensive state development, saying that the regional development is a sacred undertaking to steadily transform our life and environment into a high stage of modernity and progressive nature.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.

He met officials, scientists and technicians of the State Academy of Sciences who took part in the inauguration ceremony, and encouraged them who made a great contribution to the development of the country's paper industry by keeping the WPK's spirit of self-respect and self-sustenance as their faith.
He went round the Unsan Paper Mill.

He appreciated that the paper-manufacturing technology, capable of turning out various products with several species of wood and locally available raw materials, was introduced and a new mill of great economic efficiency and profitability was completed to provide a model experience for other provinces to build paper mills by themselves.

He said that the decision of the Party Central Committee to establish the paper industry in each province is a correct one as it embodied the principle of obtaining optimum results in construction and accurately reflected the present situation and economic potential of the regional areas.

Saying that we should maintain the clear goal and orientation of our-style papermaking method based on locally available raw materials and the development of papermaking technology in meeting the demand for paper essential in all fields such as science and technology, education and cultural life, he stressed the need for the mill to ensure the efficiency and sustained growth of production and thoroughly guarantee the quality of products by managing equipment and manpower and improving technical control in a responsible manner.

He clarified the principled issues to be adhered to in the construction of paper mills to be expanded and promoted on a nationwide scale on the basis of the experience gained in the construction and operation of the Unsan Paper Mill.
He highly praised the scientists and technicians of the Paper Engineering Institute of the State Academy of Sciences for greeting the Ninth Congress of the WPK with proud successes.

Going round the mill, the participants in the inauguration ceremony keenly felt the indefatigable efforts of the great father, who is devoting himself to implementing the regional development policy to realize the desire of the people, and were convinced of the hopeful future of the country to be further thriving under his benevolent care. -0-

cd5d09f8ba852e43028a4bb2c7fd0adf.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Oversees Long-range Strategic Cruise Missile Launching Drill
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 29 (KCNA) -- A long-range strategic cruise missile launching drill was staged in the West Sea of Korea on Dec. 28.

The launching drill was aimed at checking the counter-offensive response posture and combat capability of long-range missile sub-units, making missile soldiers well versed in maneuver and procedures of fulfilling firing missions and inspecting the reliability of the relevant strategic weapon system.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, oversaw the strategic cruise missile launching drill.
The strategic cruise missiles flew along the flight orbit set in the sky above the West Sea of Korea for 10 199s and 10 203s to hit the target.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction, saying that the result of the launching drill is a practical verification and clear demonstration of the absolute reliability and combat readiness of our strategic counterattack capability.

He stressed that checking the reliability and rapid response of the components of the DPRK's nuclear deterrent on a regular basis and steadily demonstrating their might are just a responsible exercise of the right to self-defense and war deterrence under the present situation in which the DPRK is facing various security threats.
He affirmed that the Workers' Party of Korea and the DPRK government would as ever devote all their efforts to the unlimited and sustained development of the state nuclear combat force. -0-

21a789c92728115c34fed1dc9dac7f55.title: Inauguration Ceremony of Hospital and Regional-industry Factories in Ryonggang County Held with Splendor
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) -- The second year's tasks for the gigantic regional development policy, decided and powerfully led by the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea to turn all cities and counties of the country into regional hubs of the socialist state in a balanced and simultaneous way, have been successfully carried out along with the inauguration of the hospital and regional-industry factories in Ryonggang County.

Under the WPK's grand policy on regional development, light-industry bases were wonderfully built in the twenty cities and counties this year, following last year, and modern hospitals, leisure complexes and offshore farms commissioned in several cities and counties.

This proud reality adding more pride to the era of great changes through epochal successes is a precious fruition of the noble people-first idea of the respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, who set it as a historic task to be boldly assumed and certainly implemented by our Party to provide all the people across the country with the happiest life and has pushed forward it through powerful leadership practice.

An inauguration ceremony of the hospital and regional-industry factories in Ryonggang County of Nampho Municipality was held with splendor on December 29, adding luster to the climax of the 2025 inauguration season.
Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the ceremony.

All the participants extended their highest respect to Kim Jong Un, the great master of creation who is surely bringing about entities for prosperity on this land every year with his ardent love for the people.

Present at the inauguration ceremony were leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs and other members of the central leadership body of the Party, officials concerned, officials of Nampho Municipality and Ryonggang County, working people, soldier-builders and employees of the hospital and the regional-industry factories.
Ri Il Hwan, secretary of the WPK Central Committee, addressed the ceremony.

The speaker warmly congratulated the county people on receiving the modern hospital and light-industrial factories on the same day and at the same time in 2025, the first year of the public health revolution in the new era and the second year of implementing the Regional Development 20×10 Policy.

He extended warm thanks to the commanding officers and soldiers of the regional construction regiment of the 3rd Corps for having perfectly completed the projects for the regional construction policy as desired by the Party, true to the inherent duty of the Korean People's Army always faithful to the call of the country and the people.

The fruits of the efforts for transformation which have sprung up in all parts of the country, including its northern and southern ends and inland and coastal areas, are full of impressive stories telling people what the aim of our regional revolution is and where the strength of the nonstop advance lies in, he said, referring to the great painstaking efforts and devoted leadership of Kim Jong Un who dedicated himself to carrying out the construction plan broader and deeper than last year.

He stressed that our growing ideal and self-confidence and the dynamic progress of the regional revolution are the true picture of socialist Korea displayed by the seasoned and strong leadership of Kim Jong Un, who possesses the transparent revolutionary outlook that the Party policy is the will, demand and interests of the people and regards the ardent patriotic will and the absolute standard that the people leading a happy life means national power as the supreme principle of all his revolutionary activities.

True to the long-cherished desire of the Party Central Committee to make the regional people lead a happy life as soon as possible, we should simultaneously build more structures, including modern light-industrial factories, hospitals and leisure complexes, in 20 cities and counties next year than this year and should make greater progress and a leap forward in their qualitative aspect, he said, calling upon all the officials to regard Kim Jong Un's policy on regional construction, which they kept in mind again in this inauguration season, as absolute standard, and to fulfill their responsibility and duty in creation and construction for the promotion of the people's wellbeing.

Saying that our extraordinary will and our dynamic efforts would bring earlier the future of prosperity when all the people across the country lead a happy life, the speaker expressed the belief that such achievements as today's proud success demonstrating the truth of the Party's policy and the might of Korean-style socialism would be steadily made in the hopeful New Year 2026.
Kim Jong Un cut the inauguration tape.

The participants cheered enthusiastically out of the absolute trust in and boundless reverence for Kim Jong Un who saw to it that assets of prosperity are built in their region and personally attended the significant inauguration ceremony at the end of the year, adding to the pleasure and happiness.
Lovely children presented him bunches of flowers in reflection of the unanimous gratitude of the people of Ryonggang County.
Kim Jong Un sincerely hoped that the county people who greeted the auspicious event of meaningful inauguration would lead a happy life on their land of bliss.

He met commanding officers of the construction unit that successfully built the Ryonggang County Hospital and regional-industry factories to highly appraise the loyalty to the Party and the country they displayed, and sent warm militant salute to all the soldier-builders.
Then he looked around the Ryonggang County Hospital.

He said that through the implementation of the expanded regional development policy such as building standard regional hospitals in Kangdong County, Kusong City and Ryonggang County this year, we have gone through another course for the victorious advance of the sacred cause aimed at bringing about practical change of the whole country and accumulated precious successes and experience for putting the regional construction on a definite development stage.

Making the hard-won precious creations serve as powerful engine for the development of socialist public health is a heavy and responsible revolution task whose fulfillment is as important as their construction, he said, clarifying important tasks for the operation and medical service of regional hospitals to be built in cities and counties across the country with this year as the starting point.

He said that all the medical workers of the county hospital should fulfill their exclusive duty of being responsible for the health of the citizens with high level of medical service and sincere devotion, mindful of the Party's intention of placing the lives and security of the people and promotion of their health above all else.

Noting that the inauguration of the Ryonggang County Hospital and regional-industry factories successfully concluded the construction of model hospitals and leisure complexes and regional-industry factories in 20 cities and counties planned for this year and opened up a new phase for further hastening the comprehensive development of socialist construction based on absolute support and patriotic zeal of the people, he said with pride that the year 2025 would be recorded as a historic year that proved more vividly the validity and vitality of the regional development policy through reality.

He expressed the firm belief that all the officers and men of the regional construction regiments at all levels of the large combined units of the KPA would more dynamically display the indomitable revolutionary spirit and creative mettle peculiar to our army, which remains absolutely loyal to the order of the Party and is dedicated to realizing the long-cherished desire of the Party, and always perform signal feats in the theaters of regional construction for the cause of the Party and the happy life of the people.

Leading officials of the Party and government went round the newly-built hospital and foodstuff factory, daily-necessities factory and garment factory, together with the participants in the inauguration ceremony.

The inauguration ceremony marked another occasion in further cementing the belief in the bright future of eternally prospering socialist Korea along with the brilliant results of the regional development policy which has been powerfully carried on year on year thanks to the unique state-building ideas of the great Comrade Kim Jong Un and his wise leadership. -0-

a2d31faf6529f1c21fcb0ade58baeade.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Gives Field Guidance at Major Munitions Industry Enterprise
paragraphs: Pyongyang, December 30 (KCNA) -- Kim Jong Un, general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and president of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, visited a major munitions industry enterprise on Dec. 28 to learn about the production of weapons and combat equipment.

He was accompanied by Jo Chun Ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the WPK, No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Kim Jong Sik, first vice department director of the C.C., WPK, Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration of the DPRK, and officials concerned of the munitions industry department of the C.C., WPK.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un learned about the production of multiple rocket launchers to be equipped by major units of the Korean People's Army according to the decision of the Central Military Commission of the WPK.

He repeatedly praised the firm revolutionary attitude of the workers of the enterprise who are waging a labor struggle to attain the goal of producing the multiple rocket system set by the Party while increasing production every day in high spirits.
Stressing once again the importance of the weapon system being produced by the enterprise, he encouraged the workers in their production campaign.

He said that the multiple rocket system, which will be the main strike means of the KPA, would completely change the composition of our artillery force and that the enterprise plays a pivotal role in implementing the Party's military strategic policy on modernizing and reinforcing long-range artillery pieces. And he expressed satisfaction, saying that the weapon system, which will be used in large quantities for concentrated attack in military operations, is a super-powerful weapon system as it can annihilate the enemy through sudden precise strike with high accuracy and devastating power and can also be used as a strategic attack means. It is really laudable success that we are producing with our own efforts and technology the world's only operational and tactical weapon system with the greatest military effect at will to meet the demand, he added.
He also referred to the prospective modernization project of the enterprise.

He said that we should bring about a revolution in upgrading the artillery weapon system and, to this end, it is necessary to further perfect the production structure of the enterprise in particular and improve the technical foundations of processes so as to equip the enterprise with strong production capacity and thus fully guarantee the successful attainment of the munitions production goals, to be set forth at the Ninth Congress of the WPK, on a material and technical basis.

He stressed the need for the overall munitions industry field as well as the enterprise to constantly push ahead with the establishment of advanced industrial structure, steady expansion of production capacity and innovative technological upgrading capable of producing more weapons and combat equipment in conformity with the development-oriented requirements of the defence science and industry of the present era and the goal of modernizing our army and its demand.
He ardently called for further expanding the successes achieved this year and achieving greater successes through strenuous efforts in the struggle for bolstering up the defence capabilities in 2026.
His field guidance on the day serves as a new milestone of great importance in increasing the country's war deterrent in a practical way. -0-
